instruction: Fix `url_decode` so it treats '+' as a space (application/x-www-form-urlencoded); the current code leaves '+' untouched.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -32,7 +32,7 @@
 
 def url_decode(text):
     """Decode a percent-encoded (form) string, turning '+' into space."""
-    return unquote(text)
+    return unquote_plus(text)
